pseudos.text: Documentary evidence of a match between a tip from Sikar and the chemistry paper prompted the examination administrator to initiate an investigation. The National Testing Agency, upon receipt of the information disclosure, referred the matter to a federal investigative agency. This escalation to a formal investigation led to the arrest of suspects and the invalidation of the compromised exam, with a re-examination scheduled as a corrective measure.

Following the receipt of corroborating materials, the government agency responsible for the test escalated the matter. A referral was made to a law enforcement agency, initiating a formal investigation into the paper setters and translators. This enforcement action against the arrested individuals resulted in a significant disruption to the academic cycle, culminating in the cancellation of the test.
